The team bar: Overview · Tournaments · Chat · More

Your direction: the paid portal’s shape, with the bar at the bottom instead of the section row at the top; tools a coach turns on go into More. Two notices unread. The first round (fan bar kept, count on Account) is version 11 in this hub’s history.

The team bar RecommendedKeep the fan app’s bar
KeepsOne product at every width: since 10-13 the free portal on a computer already wears the paid strip and a left menu of the team’s sections, and this gives the phone the paid shape too. A coach with a free team and a paid team finds Overview first, Chat, and More last on both phones. The bar never changes as tools are turned on.Home, Scores and Chat one tap away from anywhere, and the July “tournament companion” shell.
Gives upThe 2026-07-25 business entry (“the shell difference is the value ladder”), which /strategy amends: the upgrade story rests on the season tools alone. Home and Scores become two taps, in More, and they open the fan app with its own bar (the way back is Home’s Coaches Portal card, as for a paid coach today). Explore leaves its always-visible spot (screen 3). The phone’s section row retires, a larger build.The free portal stays the one product that changes family with the screen width: the paid shape on a computer, the fan app’s on a phone.
Phone · follows from the team bar · whole screens

More: notifications, the team’s tools, the app

More holds what the bar does not: Notifications first (the paid order), the tools the coach has turned on, Explore, the fan app’s Home and Scores, Account, Help and Sign out. It is a menu, so it sits on the bar (the 2026-10-05 sheet ruling).

Phone · follows from the team bar · whole screen

Notifications: the paid page, inside the free portal

From More’s first row. Avery’s four real notices as they would read on 2026-10-15: the payment reminder waits under Needs attention until Done; the rest sit under Yesterday.

Phone · follows from the team bar · whole screen

Chat: inside the portal, as on a computer

The bar’s Chat opens the portal’s chat screen under the team header, the screen the computer’s left menu opens since 10-13. Same rooms as the fan app’s Chat.

Phone · ask P4 · whole screens, after

P4 · The settings card for a free coach’s bell

From the Notifications page’s gear: Account → Notification settings, with the way back to the portal pinned at the top. Drawn for a coach whose team is still pending, the case that dead-ends today (flag PF2). Every option shows the Pause switch; they differ in what sits under it.

The phone · round 2 · five questions

Asks

Ruled 2026-10-15: all five as recommended (“looks good, want to write up the build prompt?”; see Decisions). Each ask keeps one box per option, the recommendation first, for the record.

Follows from your direction (not asked)

The bell’s count rides More and Notifications is More’s first row (screen 3). The list is the paid Notifications page inside the free portal, More lit, no Back arrow (screen 4). Chat opens inside the portal (screen 5). Home, Scores, Account, Help and Sign out live in More. The phone’s section row retires. Say so in the note on P1 if any of these is wrong.
